entities.name: ADRB1
observations: β1-adrenergic receptor gene; Arg389Gly polymorphism was studied as a modifier of flecainide response.

entities.name: Flecainide
observations: Class Ic antiarrhythmic evaluated for control of supraventricular tachyarrhythmia.

entities.name: Flecainide genotype interaction
observations: In 159 patients with supraventricular tachyarrhythmia, flecainide control with β-blocker coadministration was 60% for ADRB1 Arg389Arg, 30% for Arg389Gly, and 0% for Gly389Gly (P=0.001); without β-blockers, control was 64%, 70%, and 60%, with no genotype difference. Assessment lasted at least two months using symptoms, ECG, and Holter monitoring.

entities.name: PMID:27500822
observations: Clinical study of ADRB1 Arg389Gly and flecainide antiarrhythmic efficacy with versus without β-blocker coadministration in 159 patients with supraventricular tachyarrhythmia.

entities.name: PMID:20625396
observations: In 145 subjects with structural heart disease, Arg389Arg was associated with higher flecainide cardioversion than Arg389Gly or Gly389Gly; abstract did not report β-blocker stratification.
